input: Build a LAMMPS data file in the class II PCFF-INTERFACE force field (INTERFACE FF 1.5) for a short PCE oligomer: one acrylate (carboxylate) unit and one acrylate ester unit carrying a hydroxyl-terminated di(ethylene glycol) chain, methyl end caps, neutralised with one Na+. Put the system in a periodic box only slightly larger than the atoms (about 2 Å of empty space on every side).
note: same chemistry as the group's EMC file REF-04
